title: Private Mortgage Insurance Premiums and Termination Terms — Rural Home Loans
content:
Private mortgage insurance on the Rural Home Loans products: when it is required, its premium bands, and the figures that govern its cancellation and termination. The Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed does not offer mortgage insurance; every figure is 0 for it.

## Terms defined

- **Required above** — private mortgage insurance is required when original principal exceeds this percentage of the original value; a figure of 0 means mortgage insurance is not offered.
- **Premium bands** — annual mortgage insurance premium by original loan-to-value band: the annual percentage of the first band whose maximum loan-to-value is at least the original loan-to-value, applied to original principal and paid monthly from escrow.
- **Request cancellation level** — on the member's written request, mortgage insurance is cancelled once principal reaches this percentage of the original value.
- **Automatic termination level** — mortgage insurance ends automatically when principal is scheduled to reach this percentage of the original value, if the loan is current.
- **30-day look-back** — for a requested cancellation, no payment 30 or more days late in this many months before the request.
- **60-day look-back** — for a requested cancellation, no payment 60 or more days late in this many months before the request.
- **Valuation fee** — fee for the broker price opinion that confirms value has not declined for a requested cancellation, USD.

## Requirement and termination figures

| Product | Required above (LTV percent) | Request cancellation level | Automatic termination level | 30-day look-back (months) | 60-day look-back (months) | Valuation fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 80 | 80 percent | 78 percent | 12 | 24 | 150.00 |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 80 | 80 percent | 78 percent | 12 | 24 | 150.00 |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 80 | 80 percent | 78 percent | 12 | 24 | 150.00 |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 80 | 80 percent | 78 percent | 12 | 24 | 150.00 |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 80 | 80 percent | 78 percent | 12 | 24 | 150.00 |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Annual premium bands (percent of original principal)

| Product | Original LTV up to 85 | Original LTV up to 90 | Original LTV up to 95 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 0.30 | 0.46 | 0.62 |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 0.32 | 0.49 | 0.66 |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 0.34 | 0.52 | 0.71 |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 0.36 | 0.55 | no band |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 0.36 | 0.55 | no band |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | no band | no band | no band |

## Reading the bands

- The band applied is the first one, reading from the lowest, whose maximum loan-to-value is at least the original loan-to-value. An original LTV of exactly 85 falls in the first band; 85.01 falls in the second.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a Country Home 30-Year Fixed loan with an original LTV of 88 percent falls in the band up to 90, so its annual premium is 0.52 percent of original principal; on original principal of 200000.00 USD that is 1040.00 USD a year.
